artwork.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a very wide, opaque seamless side-scrolling background for an illustrated Celtic medieval fantasy travel loading screen. Make a true extra-wide image around 3:1 (prefer landscape 3072 × 1024), tranquil, highly detailed hand-painted gouache storybook scenery with subtle paper texture, clean ink accents, beautiful layered atmospheric depth. Side-on travel-platformer composition: a single visibly traversable flat road runs horizontally across the whole frame, with a walkable strip at 86–90% of the image height from the top. The road spans the width continuously and stays at the exact same vertical level with consistent material and soft detailed texture. The upper sky and horizon also remain level. View looks sideways across that path to the landscape, not down it. Make the left and right outer 10–12% echo matching simple landscape, lighting, horizon and foreground at identical heights so a short horizontal overlap can loop it. Show three visually distinct stretches along one continuous scene, naturally connected, for the camera to discover as it travels right. Keep the lower half accessible to overlay walking cutout characters. No characters, animals, lettering, labels, symbols, frames, watermark or UI. Scene: Gwynthor hinterland at bright golden spring morning. At both edges use matching low, grassy hedgebanks and hazy sage hills beyond a warm sand-colored lane. Across the full width reveal lush flowering orchard and a low drystone wall to the left, then open green meadows with a sparkling river and an arched medieval stone bridge behind the lane near the middle, then a distant slate-roofed riverside hamlet among copper beech trees on the right. Cream sunlight with cool green shadows, ivy, elegant painterly detailed trees and flowers. This is a grounded, luminous old countryside, with atmospheric distant hills and enough simple sky for breathing room.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent 2-row by 4-column sprite sheet, a new set of 8 full-body walk frames for the Aleria Almanach's storybook travel page. Use a landscape 2:1 canvas with exactly eight equal square cells, no visible dividing lines. The supplied identity references define the two specific people or creature in their respective rows. The existing chibi sprite is the rendering reference: same grown-up adventurers at small 3-head-tall chibi scale, oversized expressive head, rich matte shading, detailed outfits simplified to readable shapes, warm-lensed hand-inked anime and shaded storybook cel color. Put one subject in each cell, facing screen right in a slightly front three-quarter profile. Centre each subject in its cell with generous empty padding including above heads, below feet, beside weapons, and between columns. One consistent silhouette scale, two distinct designs. The main pose sequence must clearly move: first column wide stride with near leg forward; second column a narrow passing pose with the rear knee bent, lifted boot clearing the ground; third column opposite wide stride with near leg back; fourth column an opposite narrow passing pose with the forward knee slightly lifted and the rear toe touching. Opposite arm movement and tiny cloth follow-through. Horizontally centre each repeated figure and hold body proportions, hair ornaments, costume, accessories, and lowest planted foot level consistent in its row. Full-body boots visible. Honest RGBA transparency everywhere outside the sprites, no shadows, platform, checkerboarding, text, lines, scenery or mockup. Hands relaxed and any weapon stays stowed or carried upright. Never crop props or feet. Top row, Oweta Draig from first portrait: young adult stern blue-eyed knight, deep red copper hair in a compact low side ponytail, black dragon plate trimmed in fine blood red, upright very compact travelling spear in right hand, no helmet. Bottom row, Lefraye Gafyr from second portrait: lively olive-eyed auburn adventurer with an abundant loose high ponytail, black-brown armour with a large bronze shoulder piece, bronze goat insignia and daggers stowed at the hip. Distinct hair silhouettes.
